title: Motor resistance calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly calculate the motor resistance as 1.6 Ω using appropriate formulas.

title: Total electrical power
description: Important Criteria: Student must calculate total electrical power from battery using P = UI.

title: Traction force determination
description: Important Criteria: Student must calculate the traction force needed to overcome resistance using F = kmg.

title: Mechanical output power
description: Important Criteria: Student must calculate mechanical power output using P_out = Fv.

title: Power balance application
description: Important Criteria: Student must apply energy conservation to find thermal power as difference between electrical and mechanical power.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: Student demonstrates consistent use of units throughout calculations.

title: Incorrect resistance formula
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly uses R = U/I instead of R = P_heat/I² for motor resistance.

title: Sign or factor error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student makes sign error in power balance or uses incorrect factor for resistance force.
